message.content: Thurgood Marshall was a black cabinet member who went on to play an important role in the civil rights movement. He served as the U.S. Solicitor General and later as an Associate Justice of the Supreme Court.

The black cabinet member you're referring to is probably Robert C. Weaver, who was the first African American to serve in a presidential cabinet when he was appointed Secretary of Housing and Urban Development by President Lyndon B. Johnson in 1966. Weaver played an important role in the civil rights movement as he worked on policies and programs aimed at promoting equality and providing better housing opportunities for low-income families and minorities.

One of the most prominent African American members of President Franklin D. Roosevelt's cabinet was the famous civil rights activist, Thurgood Marshall.
